lessons.keep: Unify a product family through repeated circular geometry and material details.
lessons.avoid: Using rapid model changes without indicating which product or feature is new.
lessons.open: Model chronology, capture gesture, source-title funding details, specifications and audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, give each campaign tool the same simple visual motif while showing one distinct task per tool.

comparison.story: Establish community interest and brand. → Build the hardware design identity. → Expand the product family. → Suggest saving content into a phone workspace. → Show a brief question-to-answer feature. → Return to community and the broader ecosystem. → Close the retrospective with thanks and continuation.
comparison.motion: Devices rotate or reframe in floating views, camera macros cut to full products, glowing trails surround a phone, and screen states change around a saved post and search answer. Sampling scope: 1 fps unless a closer window is recorded.

comparison.lesson: Unify a product family through repeated circular geometry and material details.
